reviews.title: TOO SLOW
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing online shopping experience!

I returned an item on October 2, and today is October 13. It’s been 11 days, and I still haven’t received my refund, even though UPS confirmed delivery on October 6.

Shipping is just as bad. I placed another order on October 6, and the estimated delivery date is October 23. That’s 17 days to receive an order!

Slow shipping, slow returns, and slow refunds. This is unacceptable customer service.

I will never shop online with MANGO again.

reviews.title: One of the worst customer service experiences I’ve had
reviews.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but my experience with Mango has been extremely disappointing from beginning to end.

I placed a Click & Collect order while on holiday because Mango’s estimated delivery date indicated it would arrive before I travelled home. Instead, it arrived after the estimated delivery date, meaning I was no longer able to collect it.

While I appreciate that delivery estimates are not always guaranteed, what followed was far more disappointing than the one-day delay itself.

I spent well over an hour with customer service, was passed between advisers, and was repeatedly assured that the store would be contacted, my order cancelled and my refund processed. Days later, I discovered this had not happened.

I then learned that my cancellation request had been sent to the store on 24 July, but Mango had received no response from its own store. Rather than taking ownership of the situation or finding another way to resolve it, I was simply told to wait until the store either responded or eventually returned the parcel after the collection period expired.

To make matters worse, part of my purchase was paid using a gift card. Because Mango would not process the cancellation, those funds remained tied up, preventing me from placing a replacement order while the items were still available.

Customer service also suggested I visit the store to tell them I would not be collecting the order. The store was hundreds of miles away because it was near my holiday destin

reviews.title: Worst customer service and delivery service I’ve ever received.
reviews.text: I’ve made about 5 orders now and every single time there is a problem. It takes weeks, sometimes months for me to received my order, if at all! With my current online purchase it took them 5 days to tell me that half the things I’d purchased were no longer available. I went online to check and all the things they had cancelled in my order were still available online in my sizes. Makes absolutely no sense! Fed up, after this final purchase I will no longer be buying from them online until they fix all these issues. And every time I try to talk to someone about it it’s impossible to find someone who speaks English. For a global brand this is not good enough.

reviews.title: Why can't I see the dates of my purchases?
reviews.text: Why can't I see the dates of my purchases? I don't understand why no one is talking about this! I believe it is wrong and needs to be corrected. This really frustrates me. reviews.title: “Place Order” button should be updated to say “Check Out” button
reviews.text:
The “Place Order” button in the shopping bag is scary. It looks like once you click it, you will be charged without knowing how much the final cost will be. (The actual total cost will usually add up because of taxes calculated at the checkout.) So It should just say “Check Out” otherwise it’s very confusing and I would hesitate to click the button. 

And the shopping bag should also indicate that tax will be calculated at the checkout based on your address.

This kind of stuff seems small, but actually very very important for user experience imo.

reviews.title: Uses an insane amount of storage
reviews.text:
The app itself is about 60 MB, but once you start browsing products, all images and data are stored on the phone. The app ended up taking almost 3 GB of storage.
Deleting the app and reinstalling it helps temporarily, but as soon as you start loading products again, the storage usage increases all over again. This is way too much for a shopping app. Poor cache management.
